history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration continue its efforts to strictly monitor expenditure under furniture and equipment.
history.administration_response: As indicated by the General Assembly, the primary consideration for the allocation of resources is the efficient and effective implementation of mandates. In formulating budget proposals, programme managers are required to balance the need to implement mandates in an efficient and effective manner, and to use realistic assumptions that factor in past trends in their budget proposals (A/72/5 (Vol. I), chap. II, para. 324). The Controller issued a memorandum to heads of entity (as mentioned in previous responses) requesting the close monitoring of expenditures in the light of expenditure trends. The Administration will continue to monitor expenditures under furniture and equipment. Material variances at the section level or budget class level will be justified in the context of the financial performance report, in accordance with the established practice. The Administration requests the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Controller issued a memorandum to heads of entity to request close monitoring of expenditures on furniture and equipment and that the Administration will continue to monitor expenditures under furniture and equipment, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
